Derived records must be versioned, reviewable and source-traceable. Require actual human specification approval and separate plan approval before product implementation; never infer or fabricate approvals.

A structural Genesis specification check is not human specification approval, not implementation-plan approval, and not execution of the product acceptance tests. Do not implement or create implementation tasks before actual required approvals. Keep unapproved proposals and open questions explicit.

decisions.text: Label conversation decision points governed by ADR-001, not ADR documents. Target is reviewed next action and optional draft. Link labels to applicable ADR/policy versions. Permit model approval for routine cases and human review for uncertainty. Support accept, reject, revise, uncertain, multiple reviewers and adjudication. Export JSON. decisions.title: Reproducibility and provider boundary
decisions.text: User requests both exact regeneration of accepted artifacts and repeatable model calls with sufficient execution provenance; identical fresh model outputs are not guaranteed. OpenAI GPT is a permitted provider in principle. Provider retention and local sensitive-artifact retention remain unresolved. No external source-text or private-prompt transmission is authorized until boundaries are resolved.

decisions.title: Proposed implementation sequence and minimal runtime
decisions.text: For plan review, propose Python standard library plus SQLite and a loopback-only plain HTML/JS review interface. IMPLEMENTATION.md describes private storage, phase-A separation, transactional review, model capture/replay, audit, deterministic release and recovery. IMP-1 through IMP-5 are sequential bounded tasks; only the first becomes eligible after plan approval, and each requires independent human review. Full queued coverage addresses all 57 specification requirements without one oversized implementation task. No product code or tests have been written. This is a planning proposal, not recorded human plan approval.
decisions.source: IMPLEMENTATION.md; approved SPEC.md; user requested implementation plan
